analysis.summary: Only Public.com published anything new in the last 30 days, with 4 pages. Walnut and Composer rely on huge templated page sets, and Clera and Titan show no pages in this data.

points.text: Public.com is the only active publisher: 4 new pages, with no updates to older pages. Four pages is a weak signal, not a strategy.
Walnut and Composer own big templated page sets (stocks, ETFs, comparisons, strategies), but neither published new pages in 30 days.
Clera has no pages in this data, so every rival's content is ground Clera has not yet covered.

Public.com.play: Mixes broker explainers, a calculator and a comparison, plus one page on its AI tool Meta Muse.

Walnut.aimed: Search visitors looking up stocks and ETFs

Composer.play: Builds scale from 3230 ETF pages and 1386 trading-strategy pages, plus 145 ETF comparisons.

Magnifi.play: 269 pages on the site, but no recent publishing in the data.

Titan.play: No pages found in the data.

Clera.play: No pages found in the data and no activity in 30 days.

shared.title: Templated page libraries
shared.text: Walnut and Composer both mass-produce pages for ETFs and comparisons (Walnut 2210 ETF pages, Composer 3230). Clera would struggle to match that volume, so it should pick narrower topics.

gaps.title: Chat-based stock picks explainers
gaps.text: Only Public.com has one AI-tool page (Meta Muse). No one shows guides on how to use chat for picks, so Clera could own the topic.

gaps.title: AI trade execution safety
gaps.text: No rival page covers how AI-assisted trades are placed, checked or limited. Retail investors likely want trust and control answers.

gaps.title: Fresh, updated content
gaps.text: No rival updated any older pages in 30 days. Regularly refreshed guides and comparisons could stand out.
